message.content: {"verdict": "conflict", "citations": ["rbi-13139"], "confidence": 1.0, "rationale": "Clause 3.2 permits a service provider to engage subcontractors after merely informing the Bank in writing, whereas the RBI Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Managing Risks in Outsourcing) Directions, 2025 mandate that the outsourcing contract must provide for the prior approval or consent of the bank."}
